question: Where are a hospital within 150 kilometers from Best Western Plus Philadelphia Airport South At Widener University, Chester, PA on the west side?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Best Western Plus Philadelphia Airport South At Widener University%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chester%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ) AS ref_poi WHERE p.amenity = 'hospital' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ref_poi.geometry::geography, 150000) AND ST_X(ST_Centroid(p.geometry)) < ST_X(ST_Centroid(ref_poi.geometry));
